2026_05_BAL_ATL.headline: Huntley faces Atlanta’s top run defense as Robinson challenges Baltimore
2026_05_BAL_ATL.paragraph1: Baltimore will start Tyler Huntley after Lamar Jackson was ruled out with an ankle injury, increasing the importance of Derrick Henry against Atlanta’s league-leading rushing defense. The Falcons have surged behind Bijan Robinson and a steadier Michael Penix Jr., forcing Baltimore to tackle reliably and avoid conceding explosive runs. Huntley must keep the Ravens’ passing game functional enough to stop Atlanta from crowding the line, while the Falcons must account for Henry even without Jackson’s rushing threat. Protection and early-down efficiency will determine which offense controls possession.
2026_05_BAL_ATL.model_rationale: Baltimore needs enough passing balance to keep Atlanta from concentrating on Henry. The Falcons can counter with disciplined run defense and Robinson’s ability to create explosive gains.
